name: Why is it important to accurately identify the leak source, not just patch the ceiling?

mainEntity.name: Why is it important to accurately identify the leak source, not just patch the ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Accurately identifying the leak source is crucial because simply patching the ceiling or addressing the visible damage without fixing the root cause will only provide a temporary solution. The water intrusion will likely continue, leading to more extensive and costly damage over time, including mold growth, structural deterioration, and compromised insulation. A precise assessment ensures that the underlying issue, whether it's a compromised shingle, faulty flashing, or a seal around a vent, is fully resolved, protecting your home's integrity and preventing recurring problems.
acceptedAnswer.description: Accurate leak source identification is vital because patching without fixing the root cause leads to recurring leaks, further damage, and increased costs.
